name: Nanchang CJ-6
summary: Chinese tandem two-seat radial-engined primary trainer; hundreds were imported to the US as civil warbirds.

wings: Low wing with a flat center section and sharply dihedralled outer panels
engines: Nine-cylinder radial in a ringed cowl
fuselage: Tandem two-seat cockpit under a long framed canopy

tellTales: Flat wing center section with outer panels angled sharply upward
Radial-engined tandem trainer on tricycle gear

confusedWith.howToTell: The Yak-52 is smaller with more uniform wing dihedral and partly exposed retracted wheels; the CJ-6 has a flat center section and upturned outer panels.
The T-34 has a slim flat-engine nose; the CJ-6 has a round radial.
The T-28 is much larger with a deep cowl and usually a three-blade prop; the CJ-6 is small with a two-blade prop.
The Yak-18T seats four in a long cabin; the CJ-6 is a two-seat tandem trainer.
